$comment: TASK-086 working latency budget (docs/testing/load-test.md §2). A DELIVERY-TEAM PROPOSAL pending AHDA's PTBC-043 NFR thresholds, set before the first measured run; not an approval. When AHDA confirms its thresholds, replace the values here and re-run load-test-report.py over the recorded results: every verdict follows from this file.

shell.basis: Sent by every page before or beside its content (session, unread badge); it must not be what the person waits for

register.basis: A register page, filter, next page or record: 1 s is the limit for a person's flow of thought to stay uninterrupted (Nielsen's response-time limits)

dashboard.basis: A dashboard composes several widgets over the caller's whole scope; up to 2 s with the page frame already shown

report-run.basis: An interactive report run returns its first page; up to 3 s, well inside the 10 s limit of attention

report-export.basis: Requesting an export only queues a job (FG-02); the request answers like any command

report-job.basis: Queue to downloadable file for a portfolio export; asynchronous, with progress shown, so beyond 10 s is acceptable
